Name: Gromitz
Description: Gromitz is an alien employed by the Byan'nantandu. He is of a child-like race who are motivated to work through the use of games. Missions are given to them using the "Galaxy Game." The game is like a scavenger hunt with a point system and bonus rounds. During a mission to retrieve a creation of Franklin Richard's, Gromitz cheated by using Cloak as an inter-dimensional gateway.
